summary: Busy Sandford Street kerb with cars parked, homes 12-20 m on all sides.
reasons: Dwellings 12-20 m away on all sides
Flat ground, but low and near creek

best_section.where: Sandford Street north kerb, among the parked cars mid-stretch

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes and apartment blocks 12-20 m away on the north side, with more homes across the road; no bush or park backing.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a row of cars parked along the kerb, so room for a van.
drivers.convention: Cars park along this kerb all day; no sign of van overnighting.

flags: Low-lying: about 5.7 m elevation, Toowong Creek 65 m away
Signs: 2P parallel Mon-Fri 9am-5pm, and a No Parking Any Time sign near the start; check the section's own sign
Dwellings 12 m away near 37 m and 57 m
sun_shade: Mostly shaded by trees and apartment blocks on the north side; open to the south.
cannot_judge: Which sign applies at the exact spot
